texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: The setup
texts.text: The setup

texts.label: text
texts.orig: You've been handed a folder of materials from a fictional client Northwind Home Services , a residential trades business. Their support inbox is a mess. Customer enquiries land in one channel, and a human triages them by hand against an ageing SOP. They want an agent that does the first pass.
texts.text: You've been handed a folder of materials from a fictional client Northwind Home Services , a residential trades business. Their support inbox is a mess. Customer enquiries land in one channel, and a human triages them by hand against an ageing SOP. They want an agent that does the first pass.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Your job is to build that agent. We've given you everything a junior consultant on their first day would receive: an SOP, a service catalogue, a tone guide, and a batch of real-looking inbound messages. We've also given you a benchmark - a gold-standard set of how the agent should have handled those messages - so you can score your own work.
texts.text: Your job is to build that agent. We've given you everything a junior consultant on their first day would receive: an SOP, a service catalogue, a tone guide, and a batch of real-looking inbound messages. We've also given you a benchmark - a gold-standard set of how the agent should have handled those messages - so you can score your own work.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: What you'll build
texts.text: What you'll build

texts.label: text
texts.orig: An agent (single agent or multi-agent - your call) that takes one inbound customer message and produces a structured triage decision. You'll run it across the 20-message dataset, compare your output to the benchmark, and report your accuracy.
texts.text: An agent (single agent or multi-agent - your call) that takes one inbound customer message and produces a structured triage decision. You'll run it across the 20-message dataset, compare your output to the benchmark, and report your accuracy.

texts.orig: How we're thinking about this
texts.text: How we're thinking about this

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Three things, roughly in this order:
texts.text: Three things, roughly in this order:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 1. Did you actually read the materials? The SOP, catalogue, and tone guide each contain rules that interact. A good answer needs all three. Some inbound messages are deliberately ambiguous or cross-cutting - there are cases where the SOP and the catalogue disagree, and cases where neither covers what the customer is asking. We want to see how you handle that.
texts.text: Did you actually read the materials? The SOP, catalogue, and tone guide each contain rules that interact. A good answer needs all three. Some inbound messages are deliberately ambiguous or cross-cutting - there are cases where the SOP and the catalogue disagree, and cases where neither covers what the customer is asking. We want to see how you handle that.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 2. Is the agent design sensible? We don't care which framework, which model, or which orchestration pattern you use. We care that the choices you made are defensible - and that you can tell us why. A well-prompted single agent can absolutely beat a poorly-designed multi-agent system on a task this size. Pick what fits.
texts.text: Is the agent design sensible? We don't care which framework, which model, or which orchestration pattern you use. We care that the choices you made are defensible - and that you can tell us why. A well-prompted single agent can absolutely beat a poorly-designed multi-agent system on a task this size. Pick what fits.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 3. Did you grade yourself honestly? The benchmark isn't perfect. There are messages where your agent might reasonably disagree with our gold answer - we want to know when you spotted that, and what you'd change about the benchmark itself. An agent that scores 80% with sharp self-critique beats one that scores 95% and shrugs.
texts.text: Did you grade yourself honestly? The benchmark isn't perfect. texts.orig: What to send back
texts.text: What to send back

texts.label: text
texts.orig: A short write-up (markdown, doc, slides - whatever) and your code. Aim for:
texts.text: A short write-up (markdown, doc, slides - whatever) and your code. Aim for:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Your agent design in a paragraph or two - what it does, why that shape.
texts.text: Your agent design in a paragraph or two - what it does, why that shape.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · The prompts you ended up with (final versions, no need to show every iteration).
texts.text: The prompts you ended up with (final versions, no need to show every iteration).

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Your accuracy score against the benchmark, broken down by field.
texts.text: Your accuracy score against the benchmark, broken down by field.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · 3-5 cases where you disagreed with the benchmark, or where the agent struggled, with your read on why.
texts.text: 3-5 cases where you disagreed with the benchmark, or where the agent struggled, with your read on why.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · One thing you'd build next if you had another day.
texts.text: One thing you'd build next if you had another day.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Time budget: 1-2 hours. We know your time is valuable, and we've scoped this exercise so you don't need more than that to show us what we need to see. If you're three hours in, please stop and write up what you have - a partial submission with clear thinking is more useful to us than a polished one that ate your weekend.
texts.text: Time budget: 1-2 hours. We know your time is valuable, and we've scoped this exercise so you don't need more than that to show us what we need to see. If you're three hours in, please stop and write up what you have - a partial submission with clear thinking is more useful to us than a polished one that ate your weekend.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Ground rules
texts.text: Ground rules

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Use any model, framework, or library you like.
texts.text: Use any model, framework, or library you like.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Use AI to help you build it. We'd be surprised if you didn't.
texts.text: Use AI to help you build it. We'd be surprised if you didn't.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Don't hand-tune for the benchmark - build the agent, then run it. If you spot a benchmark you disagree with, note it; don't quietly correct your agent to match.
texts.text: Don't hand-tune for the benchmark - build the agent, then run it. If you spot a benchmark you disagree with, note it; don't quietly correct your agent to match.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · If something in the materials is unclear or contradictory, that's the exercise. Make a call and tell us what you decided.
texts.text: If something in the materials is unclear or contradictory, that's the exercise. Make a call and tell us what you decided.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Good luck. We're more interested in how you think than how polished it looks.
texts.text: Good luck. We're more interested in how you think than how polished it looks.
